source.label: Unchanged A512 hard index and teacher kind derived from that existing label; A1024 audit only

model.kindMask: Read-only first three one-hot candidate features; verify against stored legal keys before fit; no key/teacher input to forward

objective.kind: For present legal kinds g: a[g] = logsumexp(s[G_g]) - log(n_g); L_kind = logsumexp(a) - a[k_y]
objective.point: L_point = logsumexp(s[G_point]) - s[y] when k_y is single-cell, else exactly 0
objective.normalization: Mean per observation in the actual batch (including point-term zeros); final batch uses actual length. No class reweighting, oversampling or separate point-only denominator
objective.absentKinds: Exclude absent kinds; never log(0). One present kind gives L_kind=0; one point candidate gives L_point=0; missing teacher candidate/kind is STOP
objective.numeric: CPU float32; all CE terms use original torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy, with logsumexp minus log(n_g) for kind logits; mathematical identities do not authorize a differently rounded flat-loss rewrite; full legal mask; finite losses/gradients required
objective.reason: Kind log-mean-exp reduces direct candidate-count dependence; point conditional term targets coordinate ranking. The two-term bundle does not isolate individual causal effects

inference.selection: Unchanged raw full-list s argmax, first original index tie; no teacher-kind or balanced-kind routing
inference.probabilities: Global sum-softmax kind mass and auxiliary log-mean-exp kind softmax are different diagnostics; never substitute for actual selection

training.order: Identical cold initialization and explicit train shuffle audit; no pretrained warm start
training.selection: Per arm highest original A512 dev actual top1, earliest epoch tie; no point/oracle/NLL-based reselection
training.baselineControl: Before candidate training: reproduce original spatial history, epoch11, shuffle, logical weights, all train/dev full-list logits and prediction scores exactly; original checkpoint bytes read-only
training.initialControl: Two fresh same-seed original spatial models, one full-list call each per 428 observations; logits and initial logical weights exact

forwardBudget.scope: Only successful approved future run. Count actual calls before each top-level forward, including train/dev and chunk32 graph; no extra warmups/telemetry/common-only calls
forwardBudget.failure: STOP with partial ledger/output preserved; no silent restart, retry or extra epoch/seed/weight sweep

resources.runtime: Existing CPU PyTorch; no new dependencies, install, GPU or service
resources.scope: Owned preflight then baseline then candidate; child timer covers preparation/load/train/eval, total owner timer covers orchestration. RSS samples at load/batch-before-after/eval; not instantaneous peak

screening.decision: Technical PASS is separate. Original-four-gate screening PASS only when all four pass. Claim of both kind and coordinate improvement additionally requires both mechanism checks. All are known-dev screens, never held-out validation
screening.metrics: For train/dev: actual top1/point/reroll, teacher-point selected-kind recall and confusion, oracle point top1/top5/rank/NLL, full NLL/errors, per-fixture and teacher-kind/family/completeness/phase/legal-kind denominators, paired gain/regression vs concurrent baseline and stored original. Report each loss separately
screening.missingDenominator: STOP if original split counts, action kinds, teacher labels or full candidate order drift

boundaries.publicVerification: Stored logits/loss-history/report replay only; no model creation/load/forward/training
